description_preview:
Project Description
Join Hiredbuddy as an Entry Level Frontend Developer and build responsive, user-friendly interfaces. You'll work closely with designers and backend engineers, turning wireframes into polished, accessible web experiences using modern JavaScript and React.
Full Description
As a Frontend Developer at Hiredbuddy, you will be an integral part of our product team, helping to shape the user experience of our web applications. This is a remote, entry-level role perfect for someone with 0-2 years of experience who is eager to grow, collaborate, and make a real impact. You will work alongside senior developers, designers, and product managers to bring features from concept to production.
Your primary responsibility will be to implement responsive, accessible, and high-performance user interfaces. You will translate design mockups and wireframes into clean, maintainable code using HTML, CSS, and JavaScript. You will also work with modern frameworks, particularly React, to build reusable components and manage application state effectively.
Day-to-day tasks will include:
Developing new user-facing features and enhancing existing ones.
Ensuring the technical feasibility of UI/UX designs.
Optimizing applications for maximum speed and scalability.
Writing clean, well-documented, and testable code.
Collaborating with backend developers to integrate RESTful APIs.
Participating in code reviews and providing constructive feedback to peers.
Debugging issues and resolving cross-browser compatibility problems.
Staying up-to-date with emerging frontend technologies and best practices.
You will also be expected to communicate effectively with the team, participate in agile ceremonies such as stand-ups and sprint planning, and contribute to a positive, inclusive team culture. We value curiosity and a willingness to learn—there will be ample opportunities to attend workshops, pair programming sessions, and take on new challenges.
Our tech stack includes React, TypeScript, Redux, and modern CSS (e.g., CSS Modules, Tailwind CSS). Experience with testing tools like Jest or React Testing Library is a plus. We also encourage familiarity with version control (Git) and collaborative workflows like GitHub.
Hiredbuddy is committed to your professional growth. You will receive mentorship from senior developers, access to learning resources, and a clear career progression path. We believe in work-life balance and offer flexible working hours to support your personal and professional life.
If you are passionate about crafting delightful web experiences and want to start your career in a supportive, remote-first environment, we would love to hear from you.
Requirements
0-2 years of experience in frontend development (internships or personal projects count)
Proficiency in HTML, CSS, and JavaScript (ES6+)
Basic understanding of a modern framework, preferably React
Familiarity with responsive design and cross-browser compatibility
Ability to work with RESTful APIs and handle JSON data
Knowledge of version control, especially Git
Strong problem-solving skills and attention to detail
Excellent written and verbal communication skills
Self-motivated and able to work independently in a remote environment
A portfolio or GitHub repository showcasing your work is a plus
Benefits
Flexible remote work environment
Comprehensive health, dental, and vision insurance
401(k) retirement plan with company match
Generous paid time off and holidays
Home office stipend to set up your workspace
Annual learning budget for courses and conferences
Regular virtual team-building events

We Are
We are at the forefront of a new era in enterprise AI — one defined not by model capability alone, but by the infrastructure, memory systems, and routing intelligence required to make autonomous AI agents trustworthy and commercially viable at scale. Our applied research function sits at the intersection of frontier AI research and production engineering — investigating the foundational challenges that will determine whether enterprise agentic AI succeeds or stalls.
You Are
As a Senior Advanced AI Research Engineer, you sit at the boundary between AI systems research and production platform engineering. You investigate hard, open problems in agentic AI — and you close the loop: turning research findings into engineered prototypes, then into platform-ready capabilities that real workloads depend on. You are a strong Python engineer who can move fluently between an experiment and a well-structured service or SDK module. You write research artefacts and production code in the same week, and you understand why both matter.

Investigate active innovation frontiers in agentic AI systems — for example, agent memory and knowledge persistence architectures, model selection and inference routing strategies, autonomy and goal-anchoring control planes, and long-horizon task reliability. The specific focus areas evolve with client demand and research opportunity.

Contribute to external publications, technical reports, and conference submissions that establish thought leadership and build the evidence base for client and platform decisions.
